verdict.rationale: The documented sign-in and signing paths are credential-based and remote. A filer can connect via FranceConnect+, which substitutes for the advanced-signature requirement (docs-15), or use a qualified e-signature certificate from a certification body, including EU-recognised ones (supp-1, docs-14). The portal is also advertised as fully dematerialised with no travel required (docs-2). However, the evidence never explains how those credentials are obtained, so it cannot rule out biometric liveness, an in-person check, or mailed codes during onboarding. missing for 10: documentation of FranceConnect+/qualified-certificate identity-proofing steps showing no biometric, in-person or postal-PIN requirement, explicit MFA description, hands-on corroboration of remote completion by an authorized human.
